clock.scope: one device/rank; AIC, AIV0, and AIV1 use the same device system-cycle domain; ranks are decoded separately
clock.zero_handling: a sampled low-32 system-cycle value of zero is remapped to one so zero remains an unambiguous missing sentinel

comparison_group.label: AI Block
comparison_group.reason: AIC, AIV0, and AIV1 with the same paired core index form one physical AI Block and share a synchronized timestamp; different AI Blocks may have fixed timestamp offsets

visualization.protocol_impact: AI Block grouping and Chinese wording remain host-only; one slot per routed-expert index and dynamic record sizing are protocol v7 device ABI

fine_grained.occurrence_label: 数组下标就是本卡 routed expert index；未参与该专家的物理核保留 0 缺失值
fine_grained.wave_partition: mirror MegaMoeImpl::GetWaveExpertCount, including absorption of a final tail smaller than half a normal wave

derived_idle_gaps.label: GMM1 FIX 尾部 + 等待/调度间隙
derived_idle_gaps.caveat: 从前一专家的 MMAD/NotifyVector issue 边界到下一专家 causal begin，包含 FIX 尾部、依赖等待和少量 Scalar 调度，不能解释为纯等待指令耗时

derived_idle_gaps.label: SwiGLU 等待/调度间隙
derived_idle_gaps.caveat: 从前一专家实际输出/ready 发布后到下一专家 causal begin，主要包含 WaitForCube/输入就绪等待及少量调度

derived_idle_gaps.label: GMM2 等待/调度间隙
derived_idle_gaps.caveat: 从前一专家实际 FIX 完成并发布 ready 后到下一专家 causal begin，包含 SwiGLU-ready 等待及少量调度

fine_grained.protocol_impact: dynamic expert-index arrays are device ABI and require protocol v7; wave IDs are derived from checked header fields instead of a fixed metadata tail

protocol.record_order_description: AIC[0..aicNum-1], AIV0[0..aicNum-1], then AIV1[0..aicNum-1], each in ascending physical paired-core index
protocol.header_contract: 30 little-endian uint32 words; magic is published last after every dynamic record writer rendezvous; record_words is 2 + 4 * moe_experts_per_rank; runtime fields identify the current MTE A8W8 MegaMoeWave path and carry shape, role counts, full expert-index capacity, fine-grained flags, config hash, and y capacity
protocol.flags_contract: required 0x000003ff: v5 bits0..7 unchanged; bit8 means expert-grained timing; bit9 means full runtime expert-index records staged through the reserved workspace scratch
protocol.repetition_count_contract: header repetition_count is the exact routed-wave count derived with GetWaveExpertCount; capture_capacity equals moe_experts_per_rank and truncated is always zero because every dynamic record has one slot per routed expert index

output.carrier: diagnostic reuse of y as raw bytes after all BF16 Unpermute output stores complete; fine v7 requires bytes=4*(30 + 3*aicNum*(2 + 4*moeExpertPerRank))
output.capacity_check: adapter and device independently compute record_words=2+4*moeExpertPerRank and require carrierBytes >= 4*(30+3*aicNum*record_words); device also checks the dynamic workspace scratch against the tiling-provided 50 MiB reserve
output.write_phase: hot-path begin/end triples are written to disjoint per-role/core records in the reserved workspace tail; after role-local work_end_S, final Unpermute completion, and useful y lifetime, each core zeros and materializes its full expert-index y record; header fields follow and magic is last
output.rendezvous: AscendC::SyncAll<false>() includes AIC/AIV: first protects y from late Unpermute writers; second waits for every dynamic record before AIC0 publishes the header

points.scope: once at MegaMoeWave::Process entry per physical role/core record
points.why: Provides one local shared-axis reference for AIC, AIV0, and AIV1 inside the same physical AI Block, without asserting clock alignment across AI Blocks or ranks; also exposes role launch skew before input preparation.
points.semantics: Scalar has entered the current MTE A8W8 MegaMoeWave Process body and no operator work has yet been issued by this role/core.

dependency.precondition: mixed-kernel task entry for this physical role/core
dependency.proof: The clock is the first diagnostic instruction immediately before the first Process statement.

points.perturbation: One 32-bit GetSystemCycle and one named Scalar assignment per role/core.

points.scope: once after useful work and overflow-mode restoration per physical role/core record
points.why: Separates the real role-local useful-work tail from the diagnostic rendezvous and y record emission overhead.
points.semantics: All useful work owned by this role is complete; for AIV roles Unpermute has consumed its final MTE3_V completion event, and routed AIC publications already passed FIX_S.

dependency.precondition: role-local GMM/Combine completion and, on AIV, final Unpermute y store completion
dependency.producer_pipeline: FIX and Scalar for AIC; MTE3, Vector, and Scalar for AIV
dependency.bridge: existing PublishGmm2Ready FIX_S and Unpermute final MTE3_V waits; no additional hot-path bridge
dependency.proof: The sample is after ProcessRoutedExpertWaves, cross-rank completion, Unpermute's final MTE3_V wait, and control-state restoration, but before either trace rendezvous.

points.perturbation: One 32-bit GetSystemCycle and assignment before trace-only terminal synchronization.

points.scope: 每个物理 AIV1、每个实际 routed wave 一次；写入该 wave 首专家 index 对应的动态槽
points.why: Measures the actual per-wave AIV1 prefetch window, including send-count calculation, rather than the outer wave that may prefetch two waves at once.
points.semantics: The first expert in this dispatch wave is about to start SendCntCal on the AIV1 Scalar/control path.

dependency.precondition: the monotonic dispatch cursor selected this expert and any prior Combine ring reuse was drained by the preceding wave
dependency.proof: DispatchExpert is invoked exactly once per expert by DispatchExpertsUntil; the boundary cursor advances with GetWaveExpertCount, including the latest small-tail merge rule.

points.perturbation: 每个 AIV1/wave 一次动态边界判断和时钟读取；结束时追加三次互不冲突的 workspace bypass-GM 标量写。

points.scope: 每个物理 AIV1、每个实际 routed wave 的最后一个专家一次；与 begin 共用 wave 首专家 index
points.why: Proves when each AIV1 has completed the token/scale/meta-info writes that release GMM1 and permits direct comparison with GMM1 readiness.
points.semantics: The last expert handled by this AIV1 in the wave has completed all Dispatch MTE3 writes and ready publications.

dependency.precondition: CopyGMToGMPerToken has recycled every dynamic ring slot and MetaInfoCalAndDispatch has issued its final publication
dependency.bridge: trace-only MTE3_S using recycled EVENT_ID0 on the last expert of the wave
dependency.proof: All EVENT_ID0..5 Dispatch ring lifetimes are paired before MetaInfoCalAndDispatch returns; the added MTE3_S orders the last output/publication into Scalar before sampling.

points.perturbation: One MTE3-to-Scalar bridge and one clock sample per active AIV1/wave.

points.scope: 每个物理 AIC 对实际分配到 tile 的 routed expert 各记录一次，数组下标等于本卡 expert index
points.why: 把一批专家的长 GMM1 外框拆成逐专家 issue 区间，使同一 wave 内专家间的 FIX 尾部和依赖等待可以单独显示。
points.semantics: 当前专家的 Dispatch GM readiness 与前序 ping-pong 依赖已满足，本核第一个 GMM1 tile 即将发出 MMAD。

dependency.precondition: WaitForUpstreamReady 已观察当前专家 Dispatch wave count，且需要时 WaitForVector 已完成
dependency.bridge: trace-only FIX_S using recycled EVENT_ID0 before the first sampled tile
dependency.proof: 打点位于 AicComputeGeneric 的 readiness/ping-pong waits 之后；FIX_S 仅把该 causal begin 依赖传到 Scalar。

points.perturbation: 每个活跃专家一次动态状态检查、一次 FIX→Scalar causal bridge、一次时钟读取；结束时追加三次互不冲突的 workspace bypass-GM 标量写。

points.scope: 每个已捕获且本核实际参与的 routed expert，在 GroupMatmulWithSwigluQuant 返回后记录一次
points.why: 给逐专家 GMM1 一个低扰动结束边界；与下一专家 causal begin 之间显示 FIX 尾部、等待和调度间隙。
points.semantics: 当前专家本核所有 GMM1 MMAD/NotifyVector 已发出，但不额外声称 FIX 已完成。

dependency.precondition: GroupMatmulWithSwigluQuant 已返回，当前专家分配给本核的 tile 已全部发出
dependency.producer_pipeline: Scalar issue state; FIX may still be pending
dependency.proof: 采样紧跟当前专家 helper 返回；不增加逐专家 FIX_S，避免把原本可流水的 FIX 尾部强制串行化。

points.perturbation: 每个活跃专家一次时钟读取和三次 workspace 标量写；无新增完成 bridge。该 span 以 issue/半透明显示。

points.scope: 每个物理 AIV0 对实际执行 epilogue 的 routed expert 各记录一次；同一专家后续 tile 复用其 expert-index 槽
points.why: 把一批专家合并的 SwiGLU 长外框拆开，避免把专家间 WaitForCube/输入等待误认为 SwiGLU 计算。
points.semantics: 当前专家首个非空 epilogue 已完成上游 GMM1/输入就绪等待，并即将开始 SwiGLU 与 MX 量化。

dependency.precondition: the caller passed its AIC-to-AIV0 V wait or MTE2_V data-ready wait before entering the epilogue
dependency.bridge: trace-only V_S using recycled EVENT_ID0 at the common epilogue entry
dependency.proof: Every routed wave epilogue branch calls this operator only after its readiness wait; V_S orders those V-pipeline waits before the first recorded clock.

points.perturbation: 每个被捕获活跃专家一次槽检查、一次 V→Scalar causal bridge 和一次时钟读取；同专家后续 tile 不重复 begin。

points.scope: 每个已捕获且本核实际执行 epilogue 的 routed expert，在 GroupMatmulWithSwigluQuant 返回后记录一次
points.why: 标出每个专家真实 SwiGLU/MX 输出完成点，使后续到下一专家 causal begin 的等待/调度间隙可见。
points.semantics: 当前专家在本 AIV0 上的全部 epilogue tile 已返回；其量化 data/scale MTE3 写回均已完成且 ready 均已发布。

dependency.precondition: 当前专家的全部 BlockEpilogueSwigluMxQuant::operator() 调用已返回
dependency.producer_pipeline: MTE3 completion and Scalar ready publication
dependency.bridge: existing per-tile MTE3_S; no added end bridge
dependency.proof: 每个 operator 返回前已有 MTE3_S 并随后发布 ready；helper 返回后的 Scalar 时钟因此晚于当前专家最后一个 tile 的完成与发布。

points.perturbation: 每个被捕获活跃专家一次条件检查和结束时钟；不新增 MTE3 bridge，不再逐 tile 重复采样。

points.scope: 每个物理 AIC 对实际分配到 GMM2 tile 的 routed expert 各记录一次，数组下标等于本卡 expert index
points.why: 拆出逐专家 GMM2，使 SwiGLU-ready 等待不再被一批专家的外框吞入；也可验证 GMM2 是否确实近似连续输出 GM。
points.semantics: 当前专家的 SwiGLU-ready counter 已被 Scalar 观察，本核第一个 GMM2 MMAD 即将发出。

dependency.precondition: WaitForUpstreamReady observed the wave-grained swigluToGmm2Flag target
dependency.producer_pipeline: MTE3 completion published through Scalar-visible GM AtomicAdd
dependency.proof: The bypass GM polling loop runs on Scalar and returns only after epilogue MTE3_S and ready AtomicAdd; the immediately following Scalar clock is causally ordered without a cross-pipeline bridge.

points.perturbation: 每个活跃专家一次动态状态检查和时钟读取；不新增跨流水 bridge。

points.scope: 每个已捕获且本核实际参与的 routed expert，在 PublishGmm2Ready 后记录实际完成
points.why: 逐专家证明 GMM2 直写 GM 与 ready 发布完成，并把到下一专家 begin 的等待/调度间隙独立显示。
points.semantics: 当前专家本核所有 GMM2 FIX 直写已完成，且该 AIC 的 per-expert ready 已发布。

dependency.precondition: GroupMatmulGmm2 已发出当前专家所有 tile，PublishGmm2Ready 随后执行
dependency.producer_pipeline: FIX then Scalar bypass GM store
dependency.bridge: existing FIX_S inside PublishGmm2Ready; no extra bridge
dependency.proof: PublishGmm2Ready 内现有 FIX_S 在 WriteGmByPassDCache 前证明本核 FIX 完成；紧随其后的 Scalar 时钟不声称 AIV1 已观察 ready。

points.perturbation: 每个活跃专家一次时钟读取和三次 workspace 标量写；复用生产路径已有 FIX_S，不新增 completion bridge。

points.scope: 每个物理 AIV1、每个实际 routed wave 的首个非空 token range；写入该 wave 首专家 index
points.why: Exposes the publication-to-ready-observation handoff and starts Combine only after the full AIC fan-in is proven.
points.semantics: This AIV1 owns at least one token and its first expert's GMM2-ready scan has observed all AIC publications; meta-info load and first row send follow.

dependency.precondition: WaitGmm2Ready reduced all per-AIC ready cache lines to at least blockNum
dependency.bridge: existing MTE2_V and V_S in WaitGmm2Ready
dependency.proof: WaitGmm2Ready returns only after the V_S-ordered sum is read on Scalar and meets the all-AIC target; the marker is immediately after that return.

points.perturbation: One conditional slot check and one clock per active AIV1/wave.

points.scope: 每个物理 AIV1、每个实际 routed wave 的最终远端发送 ring drain 后一次
points.why: Ends Combine at actual remote MTE3 send completion rather than at Scalar issue or ring-drain enqueue time.
points.semantics: Every token row issued by this AIV1 for the wave has completed its remote MTE3 send.

dependency.precondition: DrainCombineRowRing consumed every MTE3_MTE2 event for each actually used row slot
dependency.producer_pipeline: MTE3 completion dependency held by MTE2
dependency.bridge: trace-only MTE2_S using recycled EVENT_ID0 after the drain
dependency.proof: The ring drain waits only the slots that were issued; MTE2_S transfers those completed MTE3 dependencies to Scalar before sampling.

points.perturbation: One MTE2-to-Scalar bridge and one clock per active AIV1/wave.
